seatedToss.guidance: Hlalani etafuleni, nithathe amathuba ngokuphonsa ibhegi elithambile esihlokweni esikhulu. Gcinani amaphuzu ephepheni, ndawonye.
steps: Phrintani isihloko nephepha lamaphuzu, nilibeke lilele etafuleni phakathi kwenu.
Hlalani kahle, omunye ohlangothini ngalunye. Thathani amathuba ngokuphonsa kancane kanye ngamunye, noma dlulisani uma ungathanda.
Lapho ibhegi lifika esongweni, lowo ophonse uphawula ibhokisi elilodwa ekholomini yakhe, emugqeni walelo songo.
Uma nithanda, bhekani amaphuzu ndawonye lapho nimisa. Akekho kumelwe abale lutho.
Yekani noma nini lapho noma ubani esekulungele.
seatedToss.safetyLine: Sebenzisa ibhegi elinesivalo esishelelwe ngokuqinile noma isokisi elikhishwe, hlala phansi, ungaphonseli ebusweni, futhi gcina umuntu omdala eseduze. Izinto ezincane ziyingozi yokuphunyeka.
flags: Akufanele abangaphansi kweminyaka emi-3: izinto ezincane
safety: Khetha ibhegi elinesivalo esishelelwe ngokuqinile, noma gingqa isokisi elihlanzekile. Hlola kuqala ukuthi alikho izimbobo noma izindawo ezikhululekile, ukuze kungaphumi lutho.
Izinhlamvu, irayisi nezinye izinto ezigcwalisa ibhegi ziyingozi yokuphunyeka. Zigcine kude nezingane ezincane nakubo bonke abafaka izinto emlonyeni.
Hlalani niseduze ngangokufinyelela ngesandla, futhi qaphelani kakhulu uma kukhona okungafakwa emlonyeni.
Hlalani phansi. Phonsani ngobumnene nangezansi ngasesihlokweni etafuleni, ningaze niphonse ebusweni.
seatedToss.previewLabel: Iphepha elephrintiwe: isihloko esinamasongo amathathu abizwa ngokuthi Eduze, Phakathi noKude, kusuka ngaphandle kuya ngaphakathi, nethebula yamaphuzu enekholomu yomuntu ngamunye kanye nomugqa wamabhokisi awanalutho wesongo ngalinye.
seatedToss.sheetHow: Libeke lilele phakathi kwenu. Uma ibhegi liwela esongweni, thikha ibhokisi ekholomini yakho, emugqeni walelo songo.

seasonalPack.guidance: Khetha inyanga, uphrinte amapuzzle wayo amathathu ephepha, bese wenza eyodwa, emibili noma yonke yamathathu ndawonye.
seasonalPack.monthNote: Inyanga ngayinye inezithombe zayo. Ikhasi livula kule nyanga, futhi ungakhetha enye noma yiyiphi.
seasonalPack.restLine: Namuhla akukho mapuzzle. Usuku lokuphumula nalo lulungile.

pairs.title: Hlanganisa amapheya
pairs.how: Dweba umugca usuka esithombeni ngasinye emugqeni wokuqala uye esifanayo emugqeni wesibili.
pairs.describe: Imigqa emibili yezithombe ezine ezifanayo, ngokuhleleka okwehlukile.

different.title: Yiliphi elehlukile?
different.describe: Umugqa wezithombe ezine. Ezintathu zifanayo, kanti eyodwa iyehlukile.

color.how: Faka imibala esithombeni ngendlela ofisa ngayo, ngama-crayon noma ngopensela.

seasonalPack.sheetHow: Phrinta ikhasi elilodwa. Yenza eyodwa, emibili noma yonke yamathathu, noma ngayiphi indlela.
seasonalPack.printFooter: Yenza eyodwa, emibili noma yonke yamathathu. Yima noma nini lapho ufisa.

decorateACard.guidance: Khetha isizathu, bese uhlobisa ikhadi ndawonye ngama-crayon noma ngamapeni. Akukho ikhadi elifanele ngokuphelele.

steps.fold: Phrinta ikhadi bese uligoqa libe yizigaba ezimbili ngomugqa onamachashaza, ukuze ingaphambili ibheke ngaphandle.
steps.front: Omunye umuntu uhlobisa ingaphambili, azungeze amagama.
steps.inside: Omunye umuntu uhlobisa ingemuva, noma niphendulane ohlangothini olulodwa.
steps.message: Bhalani umlayezo ndawonye. Omunye angabhala kuyilapho omunye ekhuluma amagama.
steps.stop: Yima noma nini lapho ufisa. Akukho ikhadi elifanele ngokuphelele, futhi elilula lifanele kahle njengelikhulu.

decorateACard.materials: Sebenzisa ama-crayon, amapensela ayimibala noma amapeni aneziphukuphuku. Akukho okudingeka ukusikwa noma ukunamathiselwa.
decorateACard.previewLabel: Ukubukwa kangaphambili kwekhadi eligoqwe libe yizigaba ezimbili. Ingaphambili lithi {words}, linohlaka oluyisisekelo lwamaqabunga nezinkanyezi. Ingemuva linemigqa yomlayezo nomugqa othi Ovela ku.
decorateACard.sheetHow: Gobha ikhadi libe amabili ngomugqa oqhekeziwe, uhlangothi lwangaphambili lube ngaphandle. Bhala umyalezo ngemuva.
sheetRules: Shintshanisani, noma nihlukanise umsebenzi: omunye uhlobisa ngaphambili, omunye ngemuva.
Bhalani umyalezo ndawonye, noma omunye abhale lokho okushiwo yilowo omunye.
Noma ngubani angayeka noma nini. Alikho ikhadi elifanele.

storyDice.guidance: Bheka izithombe ulandise indaba ngazo, noma ngayiphi indlela. Alikho indaba efanele.
storyDice.passed: Kulungile ukudlula. Omunye angaqala, noma ungaphonsa futhi.

quietShapes.guidance: Thepha isiqeshana, bese uthepha isikhala esisesithombeni lapho sihamba khona. Akukho okwenziwayo okulondolozwa noma okuthunyelwa.

quietShapes.spaceFilled: Isikhala {n}, {shape}, sinesiqeshana saso. Thepha ukuze uthathe isiqeshana.
quietShapes.different: Le ngxenye inesimo esihlukile kulesi sikhala. Zama esinye isikhala.
quietShapes.filled: Lesi sikhala sesinengxenye yaso. Thinta ukuze uyithathe ngasemuva.

picnicPlanner.guidance: Thinta isithombe ukuze sifakwe ebhasikidini lesidlo sasemaphandleni, uthinte kubhasikidi ukuze usikhiphe. Ibhasikidi libamba izinto eziyisithupha.
picnicPlanner.guidancePlay: Thinta izithombe ezimbili ezifanayo. Izithombe zisala zibonakala, futhi akukho sikhathi esibalwayo.
picnicPlanner.already: I-{picture} sekuyibhasikidi ngokuvele. Thinta khona ukuze uyikhiphe.
picnicPlanner.full: Ibhasikidiligcwele. Khipha okuthile ukuze kube nendawo.
picnicPlanner.notice: Lokhu kuwuhlelo lokuxoxa ngalo. Akukho okubalwayo, okulinganiswayo noma okugciniwe.
picnicPlanner.sheetHow: Phawula ngamunye umkhiqizo ngesikhathi uwupakisha. Sebenzisa imigqa emhlophe ukuze ubhale okunye ofuna ukukuletha.

scrapbook.guidanceEmpty: Khetha izithombe zakho ezimbili kuya kwezilishumi nezimbili ukuze uqale incwadi.
scrapbook.guidance: Phendulani amakhasi ndawonye, usebenzisa izinkinobho noma izikhonkwane ezibheka kwesobunxele nakwesokudla. Engeza amagama ambalwa ngaphansi kwesithombe uma uthanda. Lokho okwenzayo akulondolozwa noma kuthunyelwe.
scrapbook.lookGuidance: Bhekani wonke amakhasi ndawonye. Ningakhuluma noma nibheke nje.
scrapbook.intro: Khetha izithombe ezimbili kuya kwezilishumi nezimbili kule divayisi. Ngayinye iba yikhasi lencwadi ongalijikeleza ndawonye.
scrapbook.consent: Sebenzisa izithombe zomndeni wakho. Cela imvume uma usebenzisa isithombe somuntu ongakwazi ukuvuma.
scrapbook.privacy: Izithombe zakho zisala kule divayisi. Azilayishwa noma zilondolozwe.
scrapbook.cleared: Incwadi isusiwe. Khetha izithombe ukuze uqale kabusha.
scrapbook.captionHelp: Kuya kwizinhlamvu ezingu-80. Amagama aphawuli agcinwa kuphela kule khasi futhi anyamalala uma uyivala.
scrapbook.sheetHow: Isithombe esisodwa ekhasini ngalinye, namagama asezansi kwaso. Phendula amakhasi ngokulandelana futhi nikhulume ngalinye.
scrapbook.sheetEmpty: Khetha izithombe zakho ekhasini lomdlalo ukuze uprinte incwadi yakho, noma uprinte leli khasi elingenalutho bese unamathisela isithombe esiprintiwe.

quietScene.guidance: Bheka isithombe esisodwa ngesikhathi. Cindezela Okulandelayo noma Okwangaphambili uma usulungile. Akukho okunyakazayo ngokwaso.

collageBoard.guidance: Thathelanani izinxibo. Thinta ucezu, bese uthinta indawo engenalutho ukuzeulibeke khona. Lokho okwenzayo akulondolozwa noma kuthunyelwe.

collageBoard.needCutout: Qala ukhethe isinxibo, bese uthinta indawo engenalutho.

collageBoard.full: Zonke izindawo zinesithombe. Khipha esisodwa ukuze usishintshe, noma qala kabusha.
collageBoard.anotherSet: Iqoqo elisha lezinxibo lisetreyini. Izingxenye ebhodini zisala lapho zisekhona.
collageBoard.sheetHow: Nquma izithombe bese nithatha izinyathelo zokuzibeka ebhodini. Umuntu omdala angazinquma.

gardenPlanner.guidance: Thinta isithombe, bese uthinta ibhedi ukuze usibeke khona. Thinta ibhedi elinesithombe, kungakhethwa lutho, ukuze uliqede.
gardenPlanner.needPicture: Chagela isithombe kuqala, bese uthepha ibhede.
gardenPlanner.cleared: Ibhede {n} alina. Yibuyisele uma ufuna isithombe futhi.
gardenPlanner.sheetHow: Izibhede zibonisa izithombe ezikhethwe esikrinini. Dweba emabhedeni alinganiselayo uma uthanda.
gardenPlanner.notice: Lolu uhlelo lwezithombe lokuxoxa ngalo, hhayi iseluleko sokutshala.

coloringWall.guidance: Khetha isithombe nenani lamakhasi. Phrinta udonga, bese yilowo nalowo ekhalara ikhasi elilodwa noma amaningi. Akukho sikhathi, amaphuzu noma ukugcina okwenziwayo.
coloringWall.previewLabel: {picture|lower} ihlukaniswe ibe amakhasi angu-{n}, {across} ngokuthwala namanye {down} ngokuwela. Ikhasi ngalinye linesimaki ekhoneni lalo.
coloringWall.previewCaption: Isithombe nemigqa yamakhasi namasimaki adwetshwe kuso.
coloringWall.labelsNote: Izinhlamvu zihamba phansi kodonga kanti izinombolo zihamba ngokuthwala, ngakho u-A1 ulikhasi elisezansi kwesobunxele.
steps: Phrinta wonke amakhasi. Ikhasi lokuqala yilezi zinyathelo nomephu kadonga.
Yilowo nalowo uthatha ikhasi elilodwa noma amaningi bese *ekhalara*.
Imibala nezitayela akudingeki zifane. Wonke amakhasi ayingxenye yesithombe esisodwa.
Beka amakhasi ngokwezimaki zawo, bese uwahlanganisa ngetheyipu ngasemuva.
Yimisa udonga lapho wonke umuntu akwazi ukubona khona.
coloringWall.mapLabel: Imephu yodonga: imigqa engu-{down} yamakhasi angu-{across} ngayinye, ichazwe kusuka ku-A1 kuya ku-{last}.
coloringWall.edgeNote: Umugqa onamachashaza uphawula imiphetho yekhasi ngalinye. Beka amakhasi eduze komunye nomunye kuleli mugqa, noma uwagqumise kancane.
coloringWall.pictureLine: Isithombe: {picture}. Lolu donga lunamakhasi angu-{n}: {across} ngokuthwala nanye {down} ngokuwela.

findTogether.guidance: Shintshanisana. Ngesikhathi sakho, vula amakhadi amabili ukuze uthole iphere. Thola amapheya ndawonye.

findTogether.different: {a} no{b} ahlukile. Thatha isikhathi sakho, bese ucindezela Buyibuyisele.
findTogether.waiting: Cindezela Buyibuyisele uma usulungele. Khona-ke ithuba liyadlulela.

drawingDuet.guidance: Shintshanisana ngomugqa oyedwa ngamunye, bese udlulisa ipeni. Noma ubani angadlulisa. Akukho lutho oluthunyelwa noyiphi indawo. Isithombe siphuma kule khasi kuphela uma ukugcina.
drawingDuet.keys: Amacala okuya phezulu nasezansi nangakwesokunxele nangakwesokudla ahambisa idala lepeni emdwebeni. I-Space ibeka ipeni phansi noma iphakamise.
drawingDuet.restarted: Ishidi lihlanzekile. Umuntu wokuqala unethuba. Yibuyisele uma ungazange uyifune.
drawingDuet.saved: Isithombe sakho silungile. Sebenzisa isixhumanisi sokulanda ukuze usigcine kule divayisi.
drawingDuet.paperRules: Abantu ababili, ishidi elilodwa, amapeni amabili. Shintshanisana: umugqa noma isimo esisodwa ngamunye, bese udlulisa ipeni. Noma ubani angadlulisa. Akukho isithombe esilungile.

colorWash.guidance: Phahla umbala othambile kuwo wonke ikhasi, ngokuhlikihla ngakunye. Phakamisa ibhrashi ukuze umise, bese umisa noma nini ofuna. Akukho lutho oluguliwe noma oluthunyelwe.
colorWash.keys: Amacala okuya phezulu nasezansi nangakwesokunxele nangakwesokudla ahambisa isiyingi sebhrashi ekhasini. I-Space ibeka ibhrashi phansi noma iphakamise.

conversationCards.guidance: Fundani ikhadi ngokuzwakalayo. Azikho izimpendulo ezifanele.
conversationCards.groupSit: Hlala ngesiyingi lapho wonke umuntu akwazi khona ukubona isithombe. Umuntu ophethe ikhadi, noma idivayisi enesithombe esikhulu, ufunda isicelo ngokuphimisa kuqala.

conversationCards.groupNoSpeech: Ukudlulisa ikhadi kuvunyelwe njalo. Umuntu angadlulisa engakhulumi lutho, futhi akekho okufanele asho ukuthi kungani.

calmBreathing.started: Kuqalile. Phefumulani ngaphakathi njengoba isiyingi sikhula.
calmBreathing.finished: Lokho kwakungukuphefumula kasithupha kancane. Qalani futhi noma nini uthanda.

storyChain.guidance: Shintshanani: umusho owodwa ngamunye, yengeza isithombe esilandelayo.
storyChain.passNote: Shono umusho wakho ngokuzwakalayo. Akukho okubhalwayo noma okugcinwayo. Noma ubani angadlula.
storyChain.full: Ukhethwano lunazo zonke izithombe eziyisithupha nezine. Shono indaba yonke, noma qala ukhethwano olusha.

cards.prompt: Ngitshele ngophaya wezithelo oyithandayo noma isiphuzo esimnandi.
Uthanda ithiye noma ikhofi lakho linjani?
Yini eyenza ukudla kwasekuseni kube kuhle ngempela?
Ake wake wakhetha izithelo ngqo esitshalweni?
Kumnandi noma kumuncu: yiliphi othanda kakhulu?
Ungamemela bani ukuba beze ngenkomishi yetiye?
Yini oyicabanga njengosuku lwelanga elihle ngempela?
Amakati noma izinja, noma akekho? Yini oyithandayo ngazo?
Yiziphi izinyoni ozibona noma uzizwa ngaphandle?
Ake wake wadoba inhlanzi, noma wagcina ithange lezinhlanzi?
Isilwane esihle kakhulu owake wasibona yisiphi?
Ungathanda ukuchitha usuku olwandle noma ezintabeni?
Uma ungandiza phezu kwanoma iyiphi indawo, ibiyoba kuphi?
Yisiphi isithakazelo ongaphila nso ngaso amahora?
Yini owaziwa ngayo ukuyenza noma ukuyilungisa?
Ungamnika yiziphi izeluleko umuntu oshayo umsebenzi?
Yimuphi umculo okwenza ufune ukushaya izinyawo?
Yini eyenza ipati libe lihle ngempela?
Yiliphi ifilimu noma uchungechunge lwethelevishini oluthandayo ukubuka futhi?
Isinowe, imvula noma ilanga: yiliphi othanda kakhulu?
